# dsh-loop-detector
**Dead-loop / repetition detector with hard interrupt for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).**

Local LLMs (especially quantized / RL-tuned reasoning models) sometimes get stuck:
repeating the sam

e sentence forever, or re-running `web_search` with reworded queries
for the same topic without gain

ing any new information. This plugin watches the
agent's stream in real time, detects both kinds of

loops, and **interrupts them
hard** — not a soft reminder the model can ignore.
> 中文文档见 README.zh.md.

> **v2.0.0 targets dsh 0.2.x.** If you installed v1 on dsh 0.2.x and it never fired,
> that is expec
ted — see the next section.
## Why v1 does not work on dsh 0.2.x
v1 was written against an older dsh. Three things broke, each fixed in v2:
| Problem | v1 | Reality on 0.2.x | v2 |
| Never sees streamed text | listened to `session/event` → `assistant/chunk` | `assistant/chunk` is
no longer a live v2 session event (only the legacy-format migration packages read it) | listens to *

*`agent/assistant-stream`** |
| Interrupt does not interrupt | used `agent.steer()` as the interrupt
| `steer()` only queues a message for the **next step**; it does not abort the current generation |

`agent.cancel(cause, { keepInbox: true })` first, then `steer()` to guide |
| Retry budget never ru
ns out | reset the counter on `turn/end` | every `steer()` opens a new turn, so the counter was clea
red as soon as it grew | resets on **genuine user input** (plugin-injected messages are tracked by i
grew | resets on **genuine user input** (plugin-injected messages are tracked by id and excluded) |

v1's intent detector also tokenized on "non-alphanumeric", which collapses a whole
Chinese sentence

into a single token — so **Chinese reworded-search loops were never
detected**. v2 uses "stop-charac
ter splitting + CJK bigrams + Jaccard similarity".
## Features

- **Text-level repetition detection** — watches `agent/assistant-stream` for
`text-delta` and (optio

nally) `reasoning-delta`, with three layered detectors:
1. **Period scan**: the tail repeats with a

fixed period (default 8–256 chars) ≥4 times
2. **n-gram**: the same 64-char block appears ≥3 times i

nside the last 2048 chars
3. **Large anchor**: the trailing 512 chars reappear earlier and extend ba

ckwards
(catches "the whole plan printed twice")
- **Noise rejection**: a repeated unit needs ≥2 dis

tinct characters and ≥30% substantive
characters (letters/digits/CJK), so markdown rules (`--------`

, `|:---|:---|`) are not
mistaken for a loop.
- **Tool-call intent-level detection** — watches `tool

s/post-execute`, extracts keywords
from each call's arguments, and compares them against the union o

f the last 3 calls.
A low novelty ratio **or** a high Jaccard similarity, twice in a row, means
"sam

e task, reworded". `toolPatterns` takes wildcards, so `grep`, shell commands, etc.
can participate.

- **Hard interrupt**: the current generation is actually aborted, then a guidance message
is handed
to the model for one retry; after `maxRetries` the whole turn is cancelled.

dsh ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder`, but it is **advisory only** (injected
as context)

. In practice local models (e.g. Qwen / Ornith 35B MoE with reasoning off)
ignore it and keep loopin
g — which is exactly why this plugin exists.

> **Dependency-resolution contract**: every runtime dependency of this plugin
> (`@deepseek-ai/cordi

s`, `dsh-agent`, `dsh-llm`, `dsh-tools`, `schemastery`) is declared in
> **`peerDependencies`**. For

a `link:`-ed plugin, dsh's profile resolver routes a bare
> specifier to **dsh's own installed copy

** only when the plugin's `package.json` lists that
> name under `peerDependencies`. Do not move the

se into `dependencies`: Node would then look
> inside the plugin's own `node_modules`, and a miss fa
ils the whole plugin load.

## Configuration
### Interrupt behaviour
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `minLen` | `512` | Start detecting only after this many characters |
| `maxRetries` | `1` | Interr

upt-and-guide attempts; then the turn is cancelled |
| `action` | `'steer'` | `'steer'` = interrupt

+ guided retry; `'cancel'` = cancel on first hit |
| `cooldownMs` | `1500` | Cooldown after a hit (r

esidual chunks must not re-trigger) |

CJK bigrams exist because whitespace tokenization is meaningless for Chinese; the extra
similarity c
riterion exists because rewording in Chinese naturally introduces new bigrams.
## Limitations

- Detection is heuristic; tune the thresholds for your model. For small local models try
`minLen` be

tween 256 and 512.
- Intent-level detection compares argument strings, not meaning. A very broad
`to

olPatterns` (e.g. `'*'`) may false-positive on legitimately varied tool use.
- Interrupts are in-pro

cess: counters restart from zero after a dsh restart or session resume.
- Subagents are counted inde
pendently (keyed per agent); parent and child loops are never merged.
